n1.speaker: maya
n1.text: Quiet train today. I'm on my break. Go on, show me your Cornwall photos. I need a holiday!

translations.fa: امروز قطار خلوته. استراحتمه. یالا، عکس‌های کورنوالت را نشونم بده. به یه تعطیلات احتیاج دارم!

branches.suggestion: OK! This is me on the beach at St Ives.
branches.suggestionFa: باشه! این منم تو ساحل سنت آیوز.

branches.suggestion: Here's the first one. That's the train station.

n2.speaker: maya
n2.text: Look at that sand! And the sea's so blue. Is that really Cornwall? It looks like Greece.

translations.fa: اون شن را ببین! و دریا انقدر آبیه. واقعاً کورنواله؟ شبیه یونانه.

branches.suggestion: Really! That was taken on the first day.
branches.suggestionFa: واقعاً! این عکس روز اول گرفته شد.

branches.suggestion: It was only sunny for one hour. I was lucky!
branches.suggestionFa: فقط یه ساعت آفتابی بود. شانس آوردم!

match: this photo took on first day
that was took on the first day
recasts.echo: That was taken on the first day? Lovely!
recasts.better: That was taken on the first day.
recasts.betterFa: این عکس روز اول گرفته شد.

n3.speaker: maya
n3.text: Ha! The one sunny hour. And this one? Who's that in the background with the ice cream?

translations.fa: ها! همون یه ساعت آفتابی. و این یکی؟ اون کیه تو پس‌زمینه با بستنی؟

branches.suggestion: In the background? That's a stranger!
That's a seagull! It stole my ice cream.
branches.suggestionFa: اون یه مرغ دریاییه! بستنیم را دزدید.

cultureNote.en: Seagulls in British seaside towns are famous for stealing chips and ice cream. Many towns have signs: "Don't feed the gulls!"
cultureNote.fa: مرغ‌های دریایی شهرهای ساحلی بریتانیا به دزدیدن چیپس و بستنی معروف‌اند.

n4.speaker: maya
n4.text: Oh, the seagulls! They're gangsters. One took a whole pasty from my mum's hand. Next!

translations.fa: اوه، مرغ‌های دریایی! گانگسترن. یکیشون یه پیراشکی کامل از دست مامانم قاپید. بعدی!

branches.suggestion: This is the harbour. And those are the seals.
branches.suggestionFa: این بندره. و اون‌ها فک‌ها هستن.

branches.suggestion: This is a castle on an island.
branches.suggestionFa: این یه قلعه رو یه جزیره‌ست.

n5.speaker: maya
n5.text: St Michael's Mount! You can walk there when the tide is out. Did you walk across?

translations.fa: سنت مایکلز مانت! وقتی آب پایینه میشه پیاده رفت اونجا. پیاده رد شدی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, we walked across. Then the tide came in!
branches.suggestionFa: آره، پیاده رد شدیم. بعد آب بالا اومد!

branches.suggestion: What does "the tide is out" mean?

n6.speaker: maya
n6.text: Low tide — the sea goes back and there's a path. At high tide, the path's underwater. You need a boat!

translations.fa: جزر — دریا عقب میره و یه مسیر پیدا میشه. موقع مد، مسیر زیر آبه. قایق لازم داری!

branches.suggestion: We came back by boat! It was fun.
I didn't know that. The sea is amazing.

n7.speaker: maya
n7.text: And this last one — a group photo? Who are all these people?

translations.fa: و این آخری — عکس دسته‌جمعی؟ این همه آدم کی‌ان؟

branches.suggestion: My friends from my English class. We went together.
branches.suggestionFa: دوستام از کلاس زبانم. با هم رفتیم.

branches.suggestion: People from the hostel. We had a great time.

n8.speaker: maya
n8.text: Look at you, all smiling. That's a proper holiday. You know what — I'm booking Cornwall tonight. You've convinced me.

translations.fa: ببین، همه دارید می‌خندید. این یه تعطیلات واقعیه. می‌دونی چیه — امشب کورنوال را رزرو می‌کنم. قانعم کردی.

branches.suggestion: Do it! Take the train. It's beautiful.
branches.suggestionFa: انجامش بده! با قطار برو. قشنگه.

n9.speaker: maya
n9.text: The train, of course — staff discount! And I'll guard my pasty with my life. Thanks for the holiday, even just for ten minutes.

translations.fa: قطار البته — تخفیف کارمندی! و از پیراشکیم با جونم محافظت می‌کنم. ممنون بابت تعطیلات، حتی فقط برای ده دقیقه.
